downEndpoint.shared: lie-down last sample == lie-up first sample == roll-down first sample

key26.use: audit only, not rendered by v5 clips

standing.note: v7: legacy standing kept in keyOrder as calibration reference only; no edge renders it

method: v9: v8 with walk-enter/walk/walk-exit replaced by the uniformly calibrated same-view v9 walk sheet

walkTurn.method: one uniform standing-strip scale, shared floor450; no framewise bbox fit; neutral entry and mirrored-neutral exit

v8WalkLifecycle.neutral: puppy-stride-tweens.bin.gz[20,0] embedded 1:1 with legacy floor compensation
v8WalkLifecycle.entry: neutral to walk16, RIFE4.6; exit exact reverse
v8WalkLifecycle.supersededBy: walkV9 (walk-enter/walk/walk-exit replaced); kept for provenance only

walkV9.cells: 3x3 row-major; cell0 = same-view duplicate neutral, calibration anchor only; cells1..8 loop keys

extraction.method: nearest-seed split of 9 connected drawings, original pixels

calibration.method: one similarity scale for the whole sheet: maximise silhouette IoU(>40) of cell0 vs master neutral over scales 0.790..0.802 step .0005, translation by template match
calibration.tone: none (sheet values copied; brightness reported, not adjusted)

registration.method: per key translation only: y puts lowest foreground (>40) on floor450, x minimises torso-band abs error vs registered cell0; no per-key scale, no rotation, no camera orbit

walkV9.entry: exact v8 neutral (walk-neutral key) > walk-v9-1, RIFE4.6 7 intermediates, floor translation only

feet.method: Four named paw contacts recomputed from the actual v9 walk pixels (never copied from v8).
feet.stanceRule: y within 4px of the paw 90th-percentile ground line and |dx|<=3.5px to both cyclic neighbour samples
feet.entryExitFeet: empty, as v8 (runtime pins walk loop only)

sourceCameraCorrection.method: offline same-view skull-template similarity calibration to approved neutral; no per-frame bbox fit, no runtime camera/zoom change
